climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: An Amador County AVA in the Sierra Foothills, with vineyards mostly in the south and west on slopes at 1,500 to 2,500 feet. About 310 acres are planted, and the county grows mostly Zinfandel at 59%.
